civilopediaText.text: Rising Waters!
River flooding affects tiles adjacent to waterways. Can pillage improvements, reduce population, and damage units. Wonders are protected from flooding damage.
Floods spread from adjacent flooded tiles (typically +2 from rivers).
Eruption!
Volcanic eruptions destroy terrain, create volcanic soil, and damage nearby cities and units. Air units are immune to volcanic ash.
Erupts in volcanic regions with 3+ adjacent volcanoes.

name: Natural Disaster: Storm

civilopediaText.text: Incoming Storm!
Storms disrupt movement, damage units, and scatter Great Person points. After passing, yields improve in affected tiles.
Storm movement penalty: -80% movement speed.

uniques: Great Person points lost or scattered

civilopediaText.text: Drought!
Droughts reduce food production, can pillage improvements, and increase gold maintenance costs. Deserts expand from affected tiles.
Reduces food from [tileFilter:plains] and [tileFilter:grassland] by 50%.

name: Natural Disaster: Solar Flare

civilopediaText.text: Solar Flare!
Solar flares damage technology and culture networks. Great People abilities disabled, research slowed, and cultural output reduced for the affected civilization.
Ended by discovering a technology that generates enough Great Person points.

uniques: After getting [stats:Great Person] points, disabled state ends

civilopediaText.text: Tornado!
Tornadoes damage all units in their path, destroy buildings, and uproot trees. Allows air units to move at double speed.
Tornadoes can form in storm regions.
Blizzard!
Blizzards halt all land unit movement, reduce visibility, and scatter Great Person points. Air units are immune.
Blizzard stops all non-air unit movement.

Unavailable <if tutorial [Construct an improvement] is completed>

name: Rock Band Rock Concert

civilopediaText.text: Rock Band Rock Concert!
A rock band performs a spectacular concert! This creates worldwide tourism, generates Great Musician points, and creates a cultural renaissance across all cities.
Rock concerts with authentic performance create global cultural impact and lasting tourism value.

uniques: [+10] [Great Musician] points per turn [in this city]
Rock concerts generate massive cultural influence

name: Era Transition: Golden Age

civilopediaText.text: Golden Age Achieved!
Your civilization has entered a Golden Age! Cities gain +3 Loyalty, +1 Policy Slot, and increased production. Dedications provide powerful bonuses.
Choose a dedication to guide your Golden Age: Hic Sunt Dracones, Wonders of the Ancient World, Civic Pride, or Bodyguard of Lies.

uniques: Select Dedication for this Golden Age

name: Era Transition: Dark Age

civilopediaText.text: Dark Age Begins!
Your civilization has fallen into a Dark Age! Cities lose -4 Loyalty and -1 Policy Slot. But Dark Ages allow unique Dark Age policies and can lead to a Heroic Age.
Choose a dedication to survive the Dark Age: Exodus of the Evangelists, Penitent, Commune, or Inquisition.

uniques: Select Dedication for this Dark Age

name: Era Transition: Heroic Age

civilopediaText.text: Heroic Age Achieved!
From the ashes of a Dark Age, your civilization has risen to a Heroic Age! Gain +6 Loyalty, +2 Policy Slots, and three dedications from both Dark and Golden Age options.
Choose three dedications: Heroic Epic, Age of Discovery, Monumentality, and Free Inquiry.

uniques: Select Three Dedications for this Heroic Age

name: Era Transition: Normal Age

civilopediaText.text: Normal Age Continues
Your civilization enters a Normal Age. No special bonuses or penalties. Choose a dedication to guide your era: Heartbeat of Steam, To Arms!, Monumentality, Free Inquiry, or Bodyguard of Lies.

uniques: Select Dedication for this Normal Age
